description: One-stop MCP smoke test for an authenticated user's saved Schwab broker connection. If brokerCredentialId is omitted and exactly one active Schwab credential exists, this selects it automatically. The tool checks sanitized token-refresh readiness and, by default, requests one immediate no-trade broker snapshot run through the normal Vault-backed runtime-secret path. Set includeDiagnostics=true to also return sanitized snapshot/Bot Manager diagnostics. Raw Schwab tokens, account numbers, Vault ids, runtime secret ARNs, API keys, raw runtime configuration, and secret values are never accepted or returned.
name: test_schwab_broker_connection
title: Test Schwab broker connection
